The '''robes of state''' were a type of elaborate [[Robe/Legends|robe]] worn by the government officials of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. Some [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officers]] wore a black [[Chiss officer's long tunic|long tunic]] similar to the robes of state. The robes varied in [[Color/Legends|color]], depending on the owner's [[Chiss family/Legends|family]].

==Description==
The robes of state were an elaborately layered robe. It featured an outer robe with a collar in the colors of the owner's [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] over a gray under-robe.<ref name="OF" /> Some [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officers]] wore a black [[Chiss officer's long tunic|long tunic]] similar to the robes of state.<ref name="SQ" /> There existed a version of the robe with a white outer robe, a military shoulder belt, an [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] equipped with a [[Holster/Legends|holster]], and tall boots.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==History==
{{Quote|And perhaps a change of clothing would be in order, as well.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ" />}}
[[File:Chisswomen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|"Bronze" and "Rust," [[Gender/Legends|female]] Chiss representatives of the Four Families]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] wore a short [[Color/Legends|gray and burgundy]] robe and tall boots. In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], core name "Formbi," of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] wore an elaborately layered gray robe with a yellow collar and yellow highlights.<ref name="OF" /> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> Formbi wore long, flowing robes of state in subdued shades of yellow with gray trim.<ref name="SQ" /> 

In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="FHII Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> four representatives of the ruling [[Ruling Families/Legends|Four Families]], "[[Bronze (Chiss)|Bronze]]," "[[Rust]]," "[[Gray (Chiss)|Gray]]" and "[[Copper-green]]," wore bronze, rust-red, silver-gray and copper-green head-to-foot robes that respectively reflected the colors of these families.<ref name="FHII" /> At some point, a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] wore a flowing white robe and tall boots.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The robes of state first appeared in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" /> The robes were pictured on the [[:File:Outbound Flight Essential Legends Edition cover.jpg|cover art]] for the ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]'' reprint of ''Outbound Flight'', which was published on [[August 15]], [[2023]]. The picture depicted the robes of Syndic Mitth'ras'safis with the yellow color<ref name="Edelweiss Outbound">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/195403/outbound-flight-star-wars-legends-by-timothy-zahn/9780345456847|text=Outbound Flight: Star Wars Legends}}</ref> of the Chaf family instead of the patchwork of gray and burgundy color of the Mitth family he wore in the novel.<ref name="OF" />
